registry_info.name: procgen_extra
registry_info.description: Additional procedural generation artifacts — wave function collapse, higher-dimensional polytopes, reaction diffusion, and maze generation. The constructive side of algorithms.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Constraint satisfaction (WFC), higher-dimensional geometry (tesseracts, penteracts), Turing patterns, maze generation algorithms

wfc.name: Wave Function Collapse
wfc.description: Wave Function Collapse algorithm — generating complex patterns from local adjacency constraints. Start with superposition of all possibilities, observe one tile, propagate constraints until the world resolves.

reaction_diffusion_vr.name: Reaction Diffusion (VR)
reaction_diffusion_vr.description: Turing reaction-diffusion patterns in VR — two chemicals activating and inhibiting each other, producing spots, stripes, and labyrinthine patterns. The math behind animal markings.

tesseract_tunnel.name: Tesseract Tunnel
tesseract_tunnel.description: Fly through a tunnel of rotating tesseracts — 4D hypercubes projected into 3D, their inner and outer cubes visible simultaneously. Experience the shadow of a higher dimension.

penteract_double_projection.name: Penteract Double Projection
penteract_double_projection.description: 5D hypercube (penteract) projected twice — from 5D to 4D to 3D. The shadow of a shadow of a higher-dimensional object, revealing structure invisible from any single viewpoint.

maze_generator.name: Maze Generator
maze_generator.description: Procedural maze generation — watch walls carve out paths through depth-first search, recursive backtracking, or randomized algorithms. Every maze is a spanning tree of a grid graph.

room_grammar.name: Room Grammar
room_grammar.description: Shape grammar for architectural floor plans — binary space partitioning recursively splits a rectangle into rooms, draws wall outlines, adds door gaps, and colors rooms by area. The algorithmic foundation behind roguelike dungeon generation.

terrain_erosion.name: Terrain Erosion
terrain_erosion.description: Hydraulic erosion on a procedural heightmap — layered sin-wave terrain eroded by 800 virtual water droplets flowing downhill, carrying and depositing sediment. ImmediateMesh surface colored by altitude: water, beach, grass, rock, snow.
